notes.title: Update #2 for Windows is available now
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

A small update is rolling out now for Windows which contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]Updated nGlide from 1.04 to 2.00,
[*]Updated install instructions to include DirectX 9.0c when first starting the game.
[/list] 
Regards,
Daniel G,
Night Dive Studios

notes.title: FLAC soundtrack added and MacOS version fixed
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

A small update is out now for Wizardry 8, no changes in the Windows version other than the addition of the FLAC version of the soundtrack. The MacOS version has received fixes which will allow it to start on High Sierra as well as an upgrade to Wine 2.16 over 1.7.54.

Daniel
Nightdive Studfios

notes.title: New update out now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A small update for Wizardry 8 is available now. It contains the following:

[list]
[*] (Windows) nGlide was updated to 1.04 from 1.02
[*] (Mac OS X) The game will now launch on OS X 10.11
[*] (Mac OS X) Wine was updated to 1.7.54
[/list]

Enjoy!
